item.tib: kun bzang thugs kyi yang thig rgyud las theg dgu'i sa lam dbye ba dug lnga rang grol gyi gdams pa
item.coloph: kun bzang mthar thug gi yang snying la/ thegs dgu'i sa lam dbye zhing dug lnga rang grol chen por gdams pa 'di ni/ gsang ba bla med kun bzang gi dgongs pa/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang chen po'i thugs bcud/ mkha' 'gro sgol byed dmar mo'i snyan rgyud 'di/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub mtshan gyi snyan du brgyud pa'o/ me lug zla tshes bzang po'i nyin par shel brag rdzong gi mngon dga' rtse ru bkod pa sarba mang+galam//
